'''''Seinar T5D''''' was a civilian [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] that passed an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs checkpoint. A [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] was then launched and inspected to find [[workers]] in the cargo.
